# Count occurrences of each country based on the Cyclist column
# Extract country abbreviation from parentheses in Cyclist column
df['Country'] = df['Cyclist'].str.extract(r'\((.*?)\)')
# Count rows per country (each row is a cyclist)
country_counts = df['Country'].value_counts()
# Find the country with the maximum count
most_common_country = country_counts.idxmax()
answer = most_common_country
